description: Current prices for many cards in one call (ids per call: Basic 25, Pro 100, Ultra 500, Mega 750), same figures as flipzi_get_price. Ids may be Flipzi UUIDs or pokemontcg.io ids ("sv3-125"); unknown ids come back in not_found. Requires the basic plan or higher. Cost: 1 unit per distinct id, counted against this session's unit budget before the request is sent: a batch bigger than what is left of it (FLIPZI_MCP_MAX_UNITS, default 150) is refused without a request.

card_ids.description: Card ids (UUIDs from flipzi_search_cards, or pokemontcg.io ids). Duplicates are sent and charged once.

grade.description: Grade code, e.g. RAW, PSA_10, BGS_9.5. Graded values need the Pro plan.

name: flipzi_get_prices_bulk
title: Current prices for many cards
